name: Entry Point
description: Application bootstrap that wires up the platform abstraction, manages the serial/heartbeat threads, AMT COM port detection, and the agent's version metadata.

name: Platform Abstraction
description: The OS-agnostic interface (Platform, SystemState) that defines the contract for networking, serial I/O, and system metrics, decoupling the agent's core logic from concrete OS implementations.

name: Platform Implementations
description: Concrete Windows and Linux implementations of the Platform interface, including Windows service lifecycle, COM/WMI/PDH metric collection, registry access, and D-Bus/syslog integration on Linux.

name: Feature Modules
description: Self-contained hardware and OS-integration modules consumed primarily from main.cpp: serial communication, metrics collection/caching, Windows service management, session monitoring, tray UI, registry editing, and HX2K/HX3K CPU detection.

name: Build System
description: CMake build configuration, Windows/Linux build and signing scripts, Windows resource files, and repository setup utilities that compile and version the agent executable.

name: Deployment & Packaging
description: Windows service installer/uninstaller scripts, the systemd unit, and the full Debian packaging toolchain (control, rules, postinst/postrm/prerm, compat files) that package and deploy the agent as a host service.

name: Documentation
description: Project README and release-notes/changelog files describing build, install, and usage instructions plus the chronological history of agent releases.
